documents.content: Each row of the attendance table references one row of the courses table: attendance.course_id references courses.course_id. documents.content:
Stores aggregated class attendance for a student in a course during a term.

Columns:
- attendance_id: integer, primary key
- student_id: integer, not null, references students.student_id
- course_id: integer, not null, references courses.course_id
- classes_held: smallint, not null
- classes_attended: smallint, not null
- attendance_percentage: numeric(5, 2), not null (Percentage of held classes the student attended.)
- academic_year: integer, not null
- semester: smallint, not null
documents.title: attendance table

documents.content:
Stores the courses offered by departments and their credit weights.

Columns:
- course_id: integer, primary key
- course_code: varchar(12), not null, unique (Short unique code for the course (for example CSE101).)
- course_name: text, not null
- credits: smallint, not null
- department_id: integer, not null, references departments.department_id
documents.title: courses table

documents.content:
Stores the academic departments of the college.

Columns:
- department_id: integer, primary key
- department_name: text, not null, unique
- department_code: varchar(10), not null, unique
documents.title: departments table

documents.content:
Records which students are enrolled in which courses for an academic year and semester.

Columns:
- enrollment_id: integer, primary key
- student_id: integer, not null, references students.student_id
- course_id: integer, not null, references courses.course_id
- academic_year: integer, not null
- semester: smallint, not null
documents.title: enrollments table

documents.content:
Stores the marks a student obtained for one exam of a course in a given term.

Columns:
- mark_id: integer, primary key
- student_id: integer, not null, references students.student_id
- course_id: integer, not null, references courses.course_id
- exam_type: varchar(20), not null (Kind of exam, such as quiz, midterm, or final.)
- marks: numeric(5, 2), not null
- academic_year: integer, not null
- semester: smallint, not null
documents.title: marks table

documents.content:
Stores student information, including the department each student belongs to.

Columns:
- student_id: integer, primary key
- roll_number: varchar(20), not null, unique (Unique roll number identifying the student within their admission cohort.)
- name: text, not null
- email: varchar(255), not null, unique (Unique institutional email address of the student.)
- department_id: integer, not null, references departments.department_id
- semester: smallint, not null
- admission_year: integer, not null
documents.title: students table
